name: Ethiopian Medical Students' Association — ECUSTA
description: The official medical student representative body at ECUSTA affiliated with IFMSA and EMSA Ethiopia. Dedicated to clinical training, public health advocacy, and medical student empowerment.

committees.name: Standing Committee on Medical Education
committees.mandate: Focuses on medical education, curriculum support, and academic development for medical students.

committees.name: Standing Committee on Public Health
committees.mandate: Dedicated to public health awareness, disease prevention, and community health education.

committees.name: Standing Committee on Research Exchange
committees.mandate: Promotes medical research skills, scientific inquiry, and student research opportunities.

committees.name: Standing Committee on Human Rights & Peace
committees.mandate: Addresses human rights, medical ethics, patient dignity, and humanitarian issues in healthcare.

committees.name: Standing Committee on Sexual & Reproductive Health
committees.mandate: Focuses on reproductive health education, maternal health awareness, and combating health stigma.

committees.name: Standing Committee on Professional Exchange
committees.mandate: Facilitates clinical clerkships, professional medical student exchanges, and global clinical electives.
